never_deleted: daily/<date>.json, the lane's durable coverage record
the run log, the slot ledger and the ingest ledger of the lane
pruned: the lane's bounded operational logs, at their declared caps
the watchdog's own readings and alerts, at its own declared caps

snapshots.policy: a snapshot that would be identical to the previous one is refused and the refusal recorded; the watchdog copies its own readings, never the store

free_space.action: below the warning floor the lane keeps ingesting and the heavy publication waits; below the critical floor the tick records DISK_BUDGET_EXCEEDED and makes no market request at all

measured_growth.action: alert an operator; nothing is deleted, and the declared 256 MiB lane budget spread over the sixty days this lane observes is 4.37 MiB/day
